subject: Extract top model from modSel as an unmarkedFitGMM object (or the like) to apply to ranef()- so as to use loop

messages.author: 00d33217ce2031fe
messages.subject: Extract top model from modSel as an unmarkedFitGMM object (or the like) to apply to ranef()- so as to use loop
parts:
Howdy All,

I am looking to automate my modeling process such that R will pull the top model from modSel (containing candidate gmultmix models listed in ascending AIC) and then directly apply the top model as an unmarkedFitGMM object to ranef() to derive corrected abundance estimates from the top model.  Similarly, I would like to use the same process to identify and then apply the top model to predict() in order to derive detection probabilities for each of my surveys.  Because I am running this process for many species using a loop, I need this all to be automated.  

The problem is that while I can use indexing to identify the name of the top model from the modSel output, the indexing outputs the model name as a character value object, which cannot be in turn applied to ranef() as ranef() needs an object of the class unmarkedFitGMM (or the like).  How do I do this?

For example:

fit.mods<-fitList(fits=list( mod.1=mod.1,mod.2=mod.2,mod.3=mod.3,mod.4=mod.4,mod.5=mod.5,mod.6=mod.6,mod.7=mod.7,mod.8=mod.8,mod.9=mod.9,    
                             mod.10=mod.10,mod.11=mod.11,mod.12=mod.12,mod.13=mod.13,mod.14=mod.14,mod.15=mod.15,mod.16=mod.16,mod.17=mod.17,mod.18=mod.18,  
                             mod.19=mod.19,mod.20=mod.20,mod.21=mod.21,mod.22=mod.22,mod.23=mod.23,mod.24=mod.24,mod.25=mod.25,mod.26=mod.26,mod.27=mod.27,  
                             mod.28=mod.28,mod.29=mod.29,mod.30=mod.30,mod.31=mod.31,mod.32=mod.32,mod.33=mod.33,mod.34=mod.34,mod.35=mod.35,mod.36=mod.36,  
                             mod.37=mod.37,mod.38=mod.38,mod.39=mod.39,mod.40=mod.40,mod.41=mod.41,mod.42=mod.42,mod.43=mod.43,mod.44=mod.44,mod.45=mod.45,  
                             mod.46=mod.46,mod.47=mod.47,mod.48=mod.48,mod.49=mod.49,mod.50=mod.50,mod.51=mod.51,mod.52=mod.52,mod.53=mod.53,mod.54=mod.54,  
                             mod.55=mod.55,mod.56=mod.56,mod.57=mod.57,mod.58=mod.58,mod.59=mod.59,mod.60=mod.60,mod.61=mod.61,mod.62=mod.62,mod.63=mod.63,  
                             mod.64=mod.64))


(mymods<-modSel(fit.mods,nullmod="mod.38")) #assess model performance utilizing AIC or Rsqrd, whatever. 

> #identify top model using indexing
> top.mod <- as(mymods, "data.frame")
> top.mod<-top.mod[1,1]

> top.mod
[1] "mod.63"


# derive corrected abundance estimates from top model
ranef(top.mod)   # will not work because top.mod is really the character value: "mod.63"

ranef(mod.63)   # Obviously, this will work because mod.63 is the formal class UnmarkedFitGMM but I don't want to have to manually enter mod.63 (or whatever is the top model for each species).  I want to be able to loop through this.

Is there a simple function in Unmarked to do this?

THANKS!

-Tim
